title: Login Issues - Can't Access Account
description: Customer is unable to log in to their account. They've tried resetting their password multiple times but still can't get access.

title: Payment Not Processing
description: Customer's credit card payment keeps getting declined even though the card details are correct and the bank confirmed no issues.

title: App Crashing on Startup
description: The mobile app crashes immediately after the splash screen on Android devices running version 12 and above.

title: Email Notifications Not Sending
description: Customer is not receiving any email notifications for order updates. Checked spam folder but nothing is there.

title: Wrong Item Delivered
description: Customer received a completely different product than what was ordered. Requesting an immediate replacement.

title: Slow Dashboard Loading
description: The admin dashboard takes more than 30 seconds to load. This is affecting daily productivity significantly.

title: Unable to Upload Profile Picture
description: Customer gets an error message every time they try to upload a profile picture. Tried different formats (JPG, PNG) but none work.

title: Subscription Plan Not Upgrading
description: Customer paid for the premium plan upgrade but the account still shows the free tier with no access to premium features.

title: Dark Mode Not Working
description: The dark mode toggle in settings does not apply any changes to the interface. The app stays in light mode.

title: Data Export Failing
description: When trying to export reports as CSV or PDF, the download starts but the file is always empty or corrupted.

title: Two-Factor Authentication Broken
description: Customer enabled 2FA but is no longer receiving the SMS verification code. Now completely locked out of the account.

title: Search Filter Not Working
description: Applying filters in the product search returns incorrect results or sometimes returns no results at all despite matching products existing.

title: Invoice Not Generating
description: After completing a purchase, the system fails to generate an invoice. Customer needs the invoice for business expense reporting.

title: Account Deletion Not Working
description: Customer has submitted an account deletion request three times but the account remains active with no confirmation email received.

title: API Integration Timeout
description: Third-party API integration keeps timing out after 10 seconds. Customer needs the timeout limit extended or the API response optimized.
